description: This file defines classes related to text stream termination and processing, including terminator classes for null, carriage return, and line feed, as well as a template class for stream text handling with support for different terminators. It includes class definitions, inline methods, and template classes for managing text streams with termination detection and data transmission.

classes.name: StreamTextType
classes.description: Template class for managing text streams with customizable terminators, including data sending/receiving, state management, and handling of text data.

methods.name: IsTerminated
methods.description: Determines if a character indicates termination based on the terminator type.

methods.name: SizeOf
methods.description: Returns the size of the terminator sequence.

methods.name: Marker
methods.description: Returns the string marker for the terminator sequence.
